design_philosophy: A deeply immersive, tactical 3D map dashboard. The design uses extremely dark navy and charcoal tones to let the Mapbox 3D 'Night/Dusk' style shine. Surfaces are glassmorphic and minimal to avoid distracting from the map. Accents are strictly functional, using glowing moss green and vivid amber for interactions and emergencies.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Control Room Grid. Edge-to-edge map canvas with floating, glassmorphic control panels. Massive internal padding within the panels.
layout_and_spacing.sidebar: w-80 or w-96 floating panel with backdrop-blur-2xl border-r border-white/10

map_container.instructions: Use Mapbox GL JS with a custom 'Night' or 'Dusk' style. Enable 3D buildings, terrain, and custom lighting. The map is the background of the entire app.

emergency_button.style: bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-500 text-white rounded-full p-4 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(239,68,68,0.5)] transition-all flex items-center justify-center font-bold
emergency_button.instructions: Place floating at the bottom right. Must have an intense pulse animation.

location_card.style: p-4 rounded-xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors cursor-pointer
location_card.instructions: Used in the sidebar list. Minimal info: Title, Time, Tags.

tags.style: px-2 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-mono bg-white/10 text-white/80

time_selector.style: flex space-x-2 p-1 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-md rounded-lg border border-white/10
time_selector.instructions: Floating control to switch map between Dawn/Day/Dusk/Night. Use glowing active states.

motion.map_flyto: Smooth cinematic easing when clicking a location in the list to view it on the 3D map.
motion.panel_slide: Slide in from left/right with Framer Motion, using spring physics (stiffness: 300, damping: 30).

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup Mapbox with react-map-gl or mapbox-gl directly. You will need a placeholder token if none is provided, or mock the map visual if Mapbox is strictly unavailable.

2. Implement a full-screen layout: the map takes up 100% vw/vh, and all UI panels (sidebar, time selector, emergency button) float above it using absolute/fixed positioning with glassmorphic (`backdrop-blur`) surfaces.
3. Sidebar (Left/Right): Contains the list of saved locations, and toggles to a 'Detail View' when a location is clicked. Detail view shows photos, AI analysis, comments, and tags.
4. The Time Selector (Dawn/Day/Dusk/Night) should visibly change the map's lighting properties if supported, or at least change the UI theme slightly to reflect the time.
5. Emergency Button: A prominent red/amber button. When clicked, it should simulate sending real-time location to a contact (mock this action with a success toast).
6. AI Features: Mock an AI analysis section in the location detail that says 'AI Insight: This location correlates with 3 other photos in your gallery based on architectural style and lighting.'

7. Strictly adhere to the dark color palette: Midnight Blue (#07090F) and Slate, with NO pure black or pure white backgrounds. Use the provided Moss Green or Amber for accents, never Teal or Purple for CTAs.

8. Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the structural layout. Use Shadcn for interactive components (Dialogs for adding notes, dropdowns for tags). Override Shadcn's default borders to match the `border-white/10` aesthetic.
